title: Feminist trailblazer Gloria Steinem passes away at age 92
english: Renowned feminist activist and leader Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. Since the late 1960s, she played a pivotal role in advancing the women's rights movement. Her lifelong commitment to equality served as a major inspiration for countless women across many generations.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ የሴቶች መብት ተሟጋች ግሎሪያ ስታይነም በ92 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። ከ1960ዎቹ መጨረሻ ጀምሮ የሴቶችን መብት ለማስከበር ከፍተኛ እንቅስቃሴ ሲያደርጉ የቆዩ ሲሆን፣ ለበርካታ ትውልዶች የሴቶች መብት ትግል ትልቅ አርአያ ነበሩ።
oromo: Qabsaa'antuun mirga dubartootaa beekamtuun Gloria Steinem umurii waggaa 92tti du'aan addunyaa kanarraa boqatteetti. Bara 1960moota keessa jalqabee mirga dubartootaaf qabsaa'uudhaan beekamti, dhaloota hedduu biratti akka fakkeenyaatti ilaalamaa turteetti.

title: Haitian government calls for renewal of international anti-gang task force
english: The Haitian government has requested that the UN Security Council extend the mission of an international security task force currently helping to combat violent gangs. Foreign Minister Raina Forbin emphasized the need for ongoing global support to restore stability before the country's planned elections in December. With gang violence causing significant loss of life and displacement, officials warn that security improvements are essential to ensure the electoral process can proceed safely.
amharic: የሃይቲ መንግስት በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት የሚደገፈው ዓለም አቀፍ የፀረ-ወንበዴዎች የጸጥታ ሃይል ተልዕኮ እንዲራዘም ጠይቋል። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሯ ራይና ፎርቢን በታህሳስ ወር ለታቀደው ምርጫ ሀገሪቱ የተረጋጋ ሁኔታ እንድትፈጥር ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። የወንበዴዎች ቡድን የሚፈጽሙት ጥቃት ለብዙዎች ሞት እና መፈናቀል ምክንያት በመሆኑ፣ ምርጫው በሰላም እንዲካሄድ የፀጥታ ሁኔታው መሻሻል እንዳለበት ባለስልጣናት ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Hayitii ergamni humna nageenyaa idil-addunyaa garee yakka ittisuuf hojjechaa jiru akka dheeratu gorsa nageenyaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti gaafateera. Ministirri dhimma alaa Rayinaa Fooriibin, filannoo muddee keessa taasifamuuf jiruuf nageenya amansiisaa uumuuf deeggarsi idil-addunyaa murteessaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Gareewwan yakkaatiin miidhaan ga'u fi buqqaatiin uumamu hammaataa waan jiruuf, filannoon kun nagaadhaan akka gaggeeffamuuf nageenya mirkaneessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu qondaaltonni hubachiisaniiru.

title: Iran war live: US rules out Iran talks until ship attacks stop
english: The United States has stated it will not engage in negotiations with Iran until the country stops attacking commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, with officials noting that all military options are being considered. Meanwhile, Iranian leadership claims its oil industry is successfully bypassing US sanctions despite ongoing difficulties. Tehran has also warned that any further US military action will be met with a complex and unconventional response.
amharic: ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የምትፈጽመውን ጥቃት እስካላቆመች ድረስ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ለመነጋገር ፈቃደኛ እንዳልሆነች አስታውቃለች። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን የአሜሪካን ማዕቀብ በመቋቋም የነዳጅ ንግዷን እንደቀጠለች የገለጸች ሲሆን፣ በአሜሪካ ላይ የሚሰነዘረው ምላሽም የተወሳሰበ እንደሚሆን አስጠንቅቃለች። አሜሪካ በበኩሏ ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዘ ሁሉንም አማራጮች ጠረጴዛ ላይ አስቀምጣለች።
oromo: Amerikaa hanga Iran haleellaa dooniiwwan daldalaa handhuura Hormuz irratti raawwattu dhaabduutti marii kamiyyuu akka hin taasisne ibsiteetti. Iran gamasaatiin, dhiibbaa diinagdee Amerikaa dandamachaa hojii boba'aa ishee itti fufuu ishee kan ibsite si'a ta'u, tarkaanfiin Amerikaa irraa fudhatamu kamiyyuu deebii cimaa fi bifa adda ta'een kan deebi'amuuf ta'uu akeekkachiisteetti. Amerikaan gama isheetiin Iran irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf filannoon hundi banaa ta'uu beeksisteetti.

title: Trump hints US would not back UK over Falkland Islands due to lack of Iran war support
english: Donald Trump has suggested he might not support the UK in a future conflict over the Falkland Islands against Argentina. He expressed frustration that the British government failed to provide military assistance during his efforts regarding Iran. This stance signals a potential shift in the historical US neutrality concerning the sovereignty of the territory.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአርጀንቲና እና በእንግሊዝ መካከል የፎክላንድ ደሴቶችን በሚመለከት ግጭት ቢፈጠር እንግሊዝን እንደማይደግፉ ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል። የእንግሊዝ መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዘ ለነበረው ጥረታቸው ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ባለማድረጓ እንደተቆጡ ገልጸዋል። ይህ አቋም አሜሪካ በደሴቶቹ ሉዓላዊነት ላይ የነበራትን ገለልተኛ አቋም ሊቀይር እንደሚችል ያሳያል።
oromo: Donald Trump rakkoo fuuldura duratti biyyi isaa fi Arjentiin Gidduutti giddigaleessa Fooklaand irratti yoo uumame, UK deeggaruu akka dhabu ibseera. Murtii kana kan murteesse gargaarsa waraanaa Iran irratti taasiseef UK deggeruu dhabuu ishee irraa kan ka'e dha. Yaadni kun Amerikaa rakkoo daangaa biyyoota lamaanii irratti qabdu jijjiiruu danda'a.

title: US investigating if missile hit Iran wedding, Vance says
english: The US military is investigating reports from Iran that an American missile strike hit a wedding in the southern part of the country, resulting in at least five deaths. While Iranian officials have labeled the incident a war crime, US Vice President JD Vance expressed significant skepticism regarding these claims. The US maintains that its military operations target hostile forces rather than civilians, though authorities are looking into the situation.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡባዊ ኢራን በአንድ የሠርግ ሥነ ሥርዓት ላይ በተሰነዘረ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች መገደላቸውን በተመለከተ እየተጣራ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱን የጦር ወንጀል ሲሉ የገለጹት ቢሆንም፣ የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በሪፖርቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥርጣሬ እንዳላቸው ተናግረዋል። አሜሪካ በበኩሏ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎቿ ሲቪሎችን ሳይሆን የጠላት ኃይሎችን ብቻ ኢላማ የሚያደርጉ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ሁኔታውን እያጣራች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Humnootni waraana Ameerikaa kibba Iraanitti fuudhaafi heeruma tokko irratti xiyyiin rukutamee namootni shan ajjeefamuu isaanii gabaasame qulqulleeffachaa jiraachuu beeksisaniiru. Bulchiitotni Iraan miidhaa kana yakka waraanaa jechuun kan komatan yoo ta'u, itti aanaan pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Jeey Dii Vaans garuu gabaasa kana irratti shakkii cimaa qabaachuu ibsaniiru. Ameerikaan hojiin waraanaa ishee namoota nagaa osoo hin taane humnoota diinaa qofa akka xiyyeeffatu ibsituus, qulqulleeffannaa gochuutti jirti.

title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
english: Doctors in the United States successfully transplanted a genetically modified pig kidney into a patient, which functioned for a record-breaking 271 days. This medical milestone highlights the potential of using animal organs to bridge the gap for patients awaiting human organ donations. While the kidney eventually stopped working, the procedure provided the patient with crucial extra time and hope while he waited for a suitable human donor.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሚገኙ ዶክተሮች በጄኔቲክ የተሻሻለ የአሳማ ኩላሊትን ለታካሚ በተሳካ ሁኔታ በመተከል ለረጅም ጊዜ ማለትም ለ271 ቀናት እንዲሰራ አድርገዋል። ይህ የህክምና ስኬት የሰው ልጅ የኩላሊት ልገሳ እስኪያገኝ ድረስ የእንስሳት አካላትን እንደ ጊዜያዊ መፍትሄ መጠቀም እንደሚቻል ያሳያል። ምንም እንኳን የአሳማው ኩላሊት በኋላ ላይ አገልግሎቱን ቢያቆምም፣ በሂደቱ የታካሚው ህይወት እንዲራዘም እና ተስማሚ የሰው ልጅ ልገሳ እስኪያገኝ ድረስ ተስፋ እንዲኖረው አስችሎታል።
oromo: Ogeeyyoon fayyaa Ameerikaatti kallee (kidney) booyyee jijjiirama kimiyaawaa irratti godhame nama tokkorratti erga galchanii booda, kalleen sun guyyoota 271 guutuu hojjachuu danda'eera. Bu'aan kun, namoonni kallee namaa argachuuf eeggatan yeroo isaanii dabarsuuf qaama bineensotaa fayyadamuu akka danda'an kan mirkaneessuudha. Kalleen booyyee sun boodarra hojiin ala ta'us, dhukkubsataan kun kallee namaa argachuu isaa dura yeroo dabalataa akka argatuufi abdii akka horatu gargaareera.

title: Are Trump’s AI videos just memes or psychological warfare?
english: Donald Trump has recently increased his use of AI-generated imagery, including controversial videos depicting simulated military attacks on Iranian targets. While his team characterizes these posts as strategic communication, critics and observers are concerned about the ambiguity between political satire and real-world psychological manipulation. This trend creates uncertainty for international audiences who struggle to distinguish his actual policy intentions from digital propaganda.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርብ ጊዜ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የተፈጠሩ ምስሎችን መጠቀም አዘውትረዋል። በተለይም በኢራን ወታደራዊ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃት የሚፈጸምበትን የውሸት ቪዲዮ ማሰራጨታቸው አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። ደጋፊዎቻቸው መልእክት ለማስተላለፍ እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ ተቺዎች ግን ይህ ድርጊት የፖለቲካ ቀልድ ወይስ የስነ-ልቦና ጦርነት እንደሆነ ግራ የሚያጋባ መሆኑን ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Donald Trump dhiheenya kana suuraafi viidiyoowwan AI fayyadamuun kanneen akka haleellaa waraanaa sobaa biyya Iraanirratti gaggeeffamu fayyadamuu baay'iseera. Gareen isaa gochi kun ergaa dabarsuuf kan godhame akka ta'e dubbatanis, namoonni hedduun garuu kun qoossoo siyaasaa moo akka mala waraanaafi shiraatti ilaalamuu akka qabu shakku. Adeemsi kun hawaasa addunyaa biratti yaada dhugaa kan ta'eefi kan kijibaa adda baasuun akka isaanitti ulfaatu godheera.

title: Tunisia’s top court upholds conviction of opposition figures, activists
english: Tunisia's highest court has finalized prison sentences of up to 45 years for dozens of opposition leaders, lawyers, and activists accused of plotting to oust President Kais Saied. Critics and legal representatives argue the trial was politically motivated and lacked due process, serving as a symbol of the country's declining democratic standards. While the government maintains that the accused were threats to national stability, supporters of the opposition claim the judiciary is being used to silence dissent.
amharic: የቱኒዚያ ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰኢድን ለመጣል አሴሩ የተባሉ በርካታ የፖለቲካ ተቃዋሚዎችን፣ ጠበቆችን እና አክቲቪስቶችን እስከ 45 ዓመት የሚደርስ የእስር ቅጣት አጽድቋል። ተቺዎች እና የህግ ባለሙያዎች ፍርድ ቤቱ በፖለቲካዊ ተጽዕኖ ሥር እንደወደቀ እና በሀገሪቱ የዲሞክራሲ ስርዓት ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ውድቀት እንደሚያሳይ ይገልጻሉ። መንግስት ተከሳሾቹ ለሀገር ደህንነት ስጋት ነበሩ ቢልም፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን ይህ እርምጃ የተቃውሞ ድምጾችን ለማፈን የታለመ የፖለቲካ ክስ መሆኑን ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Tuuniiziyaa, pirezidaantii Kaayiis Sa'iid aangoo irraa buusuuf yaalani jedhamanii kan himataman hoogganoota mormituu, abbootii seeraa fi namoota mirga namoomaaf falman baay'ee irratti hamma waggaa 45 kan gahu adabbii hidhaa mirkaneesseera. Komiitoonni fi ogeeyyonni seeraa akka jedhanitti, dhaddachi kun dhiibbaa siyaasaa jalatti kan gaggeeffame fi sirna dimookiraasii biyyattii irratti miidhaa kan geessise dha. Mootummaan himatamtoonni nageenya biyyattiif sodaachisaa turan jedhee kan falmu ta'us, mormitoonni garuu murtii kana mormii ummataa ukkaamsuuf kan itti fayyadaman tarsiimoo siyaasaa ta'uusaa ibsu.

title: DR Congo joins countries pledging embassy move to Jerusalem
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has reaffirmed its intention to relocate its embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. This decision follows recent discussions between President Felix Tshisekedi and Israeli officials to strengthen diplomatic and economic cooperation. By taking this step, the DRC joins a small group of nations that have moved their diplomatic missions to the contested city.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ በእስራኤል የሚገኘውን ኤምባሲዋን ከቴል አቪቭ ወደ እየሩሳሌም ለማዛወር የነበራትን ውሳኔ ዳግም አረጋግጣለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ፕሬዝዳንት ፊሊክስ ሺሴኬዲ ከእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ጋር ዲፕሎማሲያዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን ለማጠናከር ባደረጉት ውይይት መሰረት ነው። በዚህም ኮንጎ ኤምባሲዎቻቸውን ወደ እየሩሳሌም ካዛወሩ ጥቂት ሀገራት ተርታ ተሰልፋለች።
oromo: Riipaabiliikii Dimookiraatawaa Koongoon, embasii ishee Israa'el keessatti argamu magaalaa Tel Aviiv irraa gara Yerusaalemitti jijjiiruuf murtee dabarsite irra deebitee mirkaneessiteetti. Murteen kun kan dhufeyyuu Preezidaant Felix Tshisekedii fi hoogganoonni Israa'el hariiroo diippiloomaasii fi dinagdee cimsuuf marii erga taasisanii boodadha. Tarkaanfii kanaan, Koongoon biyyoota muraasa embasii isaanii gara magaalaa mormii irra jirtu kanaatti geeffatan keessatti dabalatamteetti.

title: Why are people calling Venezuela oil deal a new form of US colonialism?
english: Critics are labeling a major oil agreement between the United States and Venezuela as a modern form of colonialism. The deal grants the U.S. authority over a significant portion of Venezuela’s oil reserves for several decades. Furthermore, the agreement has sparked controversy because it was finalized without the necessary approval from the Venezuelan legislative body.
amharic: ተቺዎች በአሜሪካ እና በቬኔዙዌላ መካከል የተፈረመውን ትልቅ የነዳጅ ስምምነት እንደ አዲስ የቅኝ ግዛት ስልት እየገለጹት ነው። ስምምነቱ አሜሪካ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት የቬኔዙዌላን ከፍተኛ የነዳጅ ክምችት እንድትቆጣጠር ስልጣን ይሰጣታል። በተጨማሪም፣ ስምምነቱ የቬኔዙዌላ ህግ አውጪ አካል ይሁንታ ሳያገኝ መፈረሙ ከፍተኛ ትችትን አስከትሏል።
oromo: Mormitoonni walii galtee boba’aa Ameerikaa fi Veenezuweelaa gidduutti taasifame akka bifa haaraa koloniyaalizimii (gabrummaa) isaanitti ilaalu. Waliigalteen kun Ameerikaan qabeenya boba’aa Veenezuweelaa keessaa harka guddaa waggoota hedduuf akka to’attu carraa kennaaf. Kana malees, waliigalteen kun hayyama qaama seera baastuu biyyattii malee mirkanaa’uun isaa mormii guddaa kaasee jira.

title: Burnham, Macron talk border security and stronger Europe-UK ties
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and French President Emmanuel Macron met in London to discuss strengthening UK-EU relations and tackling illegal migration. A key outcome of the talks was France’s commitment to deploy additional officers to its coast to help reduce small boat crossings in the English Channel. Both leaders also explored ways to boost economic cooperation, although Burnham remains cautious about fully aligning with EU market rules.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ከፈረንሳይ ፕሬዝዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን ጋር ለንደን ውስጥ ተገናኝተው የሁለቱን ሀገራት ግንኙነት ማጠናከር እና ህገ-ወጥ የሰዎች ዝውውርን ስለመግታት ተወያይተዋል። በውይይቱ ወቅት ፈረንሳይ በባህር ዳርቻዎቿ ላይ ተጨማሪ የፀጥታ ሃይሎችን በማሰማራት የእንግሊዝ ቻናልን ተሻግረው የሚመጡ ትናንሽ ጀልባዎችን ለመቀነስ ቃል ገብታለች። መሪዎቹ የኢኮኖሚ ትብብርን ማሳደግ ላይ የመከሩ ሲሆን፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር በርንሃም ከአውሮፓ ህብረት የገበያ ህጎች ጋር ሙሉ በሙሉ ከመቀላቀል ይልቅ ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አካሄድ መርጠዋል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa UK Andy Burnham fi pirezidaantiin Faransaay Emmanuel Macron magaala Londonitti wal arguudhaan hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii cimsuu fi godaansa seeraan alaa to'achuu irratti mari'ataniiru. Marii kana keessatti Faransaay doonii xixiqqoodhaan qaxxaamuranii gara UK dhufan hir'isuuf jecha, bakka dooniin itti ka'anitti poolisoota dabalataa bobbaasuuf waadaa galteetti. Hoggantoonni kunneen haala dinagdee waliin cimsuu danda'an irratti kan mari'atan yoo ta'u, Burnham garuu gabaa Gamtaa Awurooppaa keessa galuu irratti ammayyuu of eeggannoo guddaa qaba.

title: Nepal flood victims to be identified through DNA
english: Severe flash floods in the Nepalese town of Timure near the Chinese border have resulted in many fatalities. Because the bodies recovered are severely decomposed or dismembered, authorities are unable to use traditional identification methods. Instead, forensic experts are utilizing DNA testing to help confirm the identities of the victims.
amharic: በቻይና ድንበር አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው የኔፓሏ ቲሙሬ ከተማ በደረሰ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ብዙ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። የተገኙት አስከሬኖች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጎዳታቸው እና በመበላሸታቸው የተነሳ በተለመደው መንገድ ለመለየት አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። በመሆኑም የፎረንሲክ ባለሙያዎች የተጎጂዎችን ማንነት ለማረጋገጥ የዲ ኤን ኤ ምርመራ እየተጠቀሙ ነው።
oromo: Godina Timure kan biyya Nepal, daangaa Chaayinaa biratti argamtu keessatti lolaa tasaa mudateen lubbuun namoota hedduu darbeera. Reeffa argame irratti miidhaan cimaan waan gaheef, karaa idilee ta'een eenyummaa isaanii adda baasuun hin danda'amne. Kanaafuu, ogeeyyonni foorensikii eenyummaa namoota miidhamanii kana mirkaneeffachuuf qorannoo DNA fayyadamuutti jiru.

title: El Nino: A phenomenon supercharged by climate change
english: Scientists are concerned that the upcoming 2026-27 El Nino could be the most powerful ever recorded, fueled by the effects of global climate change. This weather pattern, which disrupts ocean currents and causes fish populations to migrate, is expected to intensify droughts, floods, and extreme heat worldwide. Experts warn that this event poses a severe threat to global food security, ecosystems, and the livelihoods of people who depend on agriculture and fishing.
amharic: የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት እ.ኤ.አ በ2026-27 የሚከሰተው ኤልኒኖ በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተጽዕኖ የተነሳ እስካሁን ታይቶ በማይታወቅ መልኩ ጠንካራ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ ክስተት የባህር ሞገዶችን በማዛባት እና የዓሳ ሀብትን በመበተን በመላው ዓለም ድርቅን፣ ጎርፍን እና ከፍተኛ ሙቀትን እንደሚያባብስ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ክስተት በአለም አቀፍ የምግብ ዋስትና፣ በተፈጥሮ ስነ-ምህዳር እና በግብርናና በአሳ ሀብት ላይ ጥገኛ በሆኑ ሰዎች ህይወት ላይ ከፍተኛ አደጋ እንደሚደቅን ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Hayyoonni saayinsii akka jedhanitti, El Niinoon bara 2026-27 muudatu jijjiirama qilleensaa addunyaa irraan kan ka'e hanga ammaatti kan hin mul'anneen cimaa ta'uu danda'a. Sirni qilleensaa kun jijjiirama yaa'a galaanaaf sababa ta'uudhaan akkasumas hamma qurxummii xiqqeessuudhaan, guutuu addunyaatti hongee, lolaafi hoo'a cimaa akka hammaatuuf ni taasisa. Haalli kun nageenya nyaataa addunyaa, haala naannoo fi jireenya namoota qonnaa fi qurxummii irratti hirkatan irratti balaa cimaa akka qabu hayyoonni akeekkachiisu.

title: US Vice President JD Vance declines to offer timeline for end of Iran war
english: US Vice President JD Vance has refused to provide a specific end date for the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran. During a press briefing, Vance downplayed the severity of the hostilities and suggested that the decision to stop targeting ships in the Strait of Hormuz rests entirely with Iran. He further argued that US military actions are effectively weakening Iran's defenses and stabilizing global energy markets despite the current disruptions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል እየተካሄደ ላለው ግጭት መቼ እንደሚያበቃ የተወሰነ ጊዜ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል። በሰጡት ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ፣ ቫንስ የጦርነቱን ክብደት ለመቀነስ የሞከሩ ሲሆን፣ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ላይ የሚደረጉ ጥቃቶችን የማቆም ውሳኔ ሙሉ በሙሉ በኢራን እጅ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች የኢራንን የመከላከል አቅም እያዳከሙ እና የዓለም የኃይል ገበያን ለማረጋጋት እየረዱ መሆናቸውንም ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaan pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun yoom akka xumuramu guyyaa murtaa'e tokko kennuu irraa of qusataniiru. Ibsa miidiyaaleef kennaniin, Vance walitti bu'iinsi kun hammam akka cimaa ta'e xiqqeessanii kan ibsan yoo ta'u, dooniiwwan galaana Hormuz irratti weerara gaggeeffamu dhaabuun murtoo Iraan qofa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Tarkaanfiin waraanaa Ameerikaa humna ittisa Iraan laaffisuu fi gabaa anniisaa addunyaa tasgabbeessuuf gumaacha akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: France records ‘hottest summer ever’ in 2026
english: France experienced its hottest summer on record in 2026, with average temperatures significantly higher than normal alongside severe heatwaves and drought. These extreme weather events, which included widespread wildfires and numerous excess deaths, highlight the growing impact of climate change across Europe. In response, the French government is working to fast-track new national strategies for climate adaptation and environmental protection.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በ2026 ዓ.ም ከተመዘገበ የሙቀት መጠን አንጻር በታሪኳ እጅግ ሞቃታማውን በጋ አሳልፋለች። የከፋ የሙቀት ማዕበል፣ ከፍተኛ ድርቅ እና የዱር እሳቶች በተከሰቱበት በዚህ ወቅት በርካታ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። ይህ ክስተት በአውሮፓ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተጽዕኖ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ የፈረንሳይ መንግስትም ለችግሩ ፈጣን መፍትሄ ለመስጠት አዳዲስ እቅዶችን በመንደፍ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Faransaayi bara 2026 ganna baay'ee hoo'aa ta'e dabarsiteetti; kunis ho'a qaamaa seenaa keessatti galmaa'e isa olaanaa dha. title: Ipswich Town vs Liverpool: Premier League – prediction, team news, lineups
english: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola is preparing for their upcoming Premier League match against Ipswich Town, where he hopes to secure his first win. The team recently signed French forward Bradley Barcola for 124 million pounds, making him their second-most expensive player ever. Barcola is expected to be available for the Friday fixture, joining a powerful attacking lineup despite his limited preseason play time.
amharic: የሊቨርፑሉ አሰልጣኝ አንድኒ ኢራኦላ በመጪው አርብ ከኢፕስዊች ታውን ጋር ለሚያደርጉት ጨዋታ የመጀመሪያ ድላቸውን ለማግኘት እየተዘጋጁ ነው። ሊቨርፑል ፈረንሳዊውን አጥቂ ብራድሊ ባርኮላን በ124 ሚሊዮን ፓውንድ በማዘዋወር በታሪካቸው ሁለተኛው ውድ ተጫዋች አድርገውታል። ምንም እንኳን የቅድመ ውድድር ዝግጅት ሰዓት አግኝቶ ባያውቅም፣ ተጫዋቹ ለአርብ ጨዋታ ዝግጁ እንደሚሆን ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Liverpool Andoni Iraola tapha torban dhufu Ipswich Town waliin taasisaniin injifannoo isaanii jalqabaa argachuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Liverpool weeraraa Faransaay Bradley Barcola paawundii miiliyoona 124n bituudhaan, taphattoota isaanii gatii guddaa baasanii bitan keessaa isa lammaffaa taasisaniiru. Barcola yeroo qophii tapha duraa gahaa argachuu baatus, tapha Jimaata kanaaf qophii akka ta'e fi garee weeraraa cimaa Liverpool keessatti akka hirmaatu irraa eegama.

title: 'Beautiful, vibrant' Disney star Carla Jeffery dies aged 33
english: Carla Jeffery, the talented actress recognized for her role as Bree in the Disney Zombies film franchise, has passed away at the age of 33. Her management team and colleagues have expressed deep sorrow, remembering her as a vibrant person whose positivity and bright smile left a lasting impact. Her twin brother and co-stars have shared heartfelt tributes honoring her memory and the joy she brought to those around her.
amharic: በዲስኒ የዞምቢስ ፊልሞች ላይ በብሪ ገጸ-ባህሪ የምትታወቀው ተወዳጇ ተዋናይት ካርላ ጄፍሪ በ33 ዓመቷ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይታለች። የቀድሞ የሥራ ባልደረቦቿ እና አስተዳዳሪዎቿ እሷን እንደ ደማቅ ስብዕና እና ሁሌም ፈገግታ የተላበሰች ታታሪ ሰው አድርገው ያስታውሷታል። መንታ ወንድሟ እና ሌሎች የፊልም አጋሮቿም ስለ ህልፈቷ ያላቸውን ጥልቅ ሐዘን በመግለጽ ለቤተሰቦቿ መጽናናትን ተመኝተዋል።
oromo: Aartiin beekamtuu fi filmii Disney 'Zombies' keessatti gahee 'Bree' taphachuun beekamtuu kan turte Carla Jeffery umurii waggaa 33tti addunyaa kana irraa du'aan boqatteetti. Hojjettoonni ishii fi michoonni ishii, nama gammachuu qabduu fi ifa guddaa nama hunda biratti qabdu turte jechuun yaadatu. Obboleessi ishii fi hiriyyoonni ishii hojii ishii irraa gadda guddaa itti dhaga'ame ibsuun, maatii ishiitiif jajjabina hawwaniiru.

title: Is Nepal leading the battle for climate justice?
english: Nepal’s foreign minister is calling for the world’s largest polluters—China, the United States, and India—to pay for damages caused by recent flash floods. He argues that Nepal contributes very little to global carbon emissions and should not bear the financial burden for climate-related disasters caused by others. This stance highlights the growing push for climate justice, where wealthy, high-polluting nations are held accountable for the suffering of vulnerable countries.
amharic: የኔፓል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ከፍተኛ የካርቦን ልቀት የሚያደርሱት ቻይና፣ አሜሪካ እና ህንድ በቅርቡ በሀገሪቱ በደረሰው የጎርፍ አደጋ ለደረሰው ጉዳት ካሳ እንዲከፍሉ ጠይቀዋል። የኔፓል የካርቦን ልቀት ድርሻ እጅግ አነስተኛ ቢሆንም፣ ሀገሪቱ በሌሎች ሀገራት በተፈጠረ የአየር ንብረት ቀውስ እየተጎዳች መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ ሀብታም እና ከፍተኛ በካይ ሀገራት ለአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተጠያቂ መሆን አለባቸው በሚል እየተነሳ ያለው የአየር ንብረት ፍትህ ጥያቄ አካል ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Neeppaal, biyyoonni qilleensa faaluudhaan beekamoo ta'an kanneen akka Chaayinaa, Ameerikaa fi Indiyaan, balaa lolaa dhiheenya kana isaan irra ga'eef kaffaltii beenyaa akka kaffalan gaafataniiru. Neeppaal gumaacha qilleensa faaluu keessatti hirmaannaa xiqqoo qabaattus, jijjiirama qilleensaa kanneen biroo uumaniin miidhamuu ishee ibsaniiru. Gaaffiin kun biyyoonni badhaadhonni fi faalamni qilleensaa irraa madde akka itti gaafatamaniif falmii haqaa qilleensaa irratti taasifamu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Four imprisoned Palestine Action activists appeal ‘terrorism’ sentences
english: Four activists from the group Palestine Action are challenging their legal convictions after being sentenced for damaging an Elbit Systems facility in the UK. Their case is historic because it represents the first time property destruction has been legally classified as an act of terrorism. The group is now seeking to overturn this significant and controversial judicial ruling.
amharic: የፍልስጤም አክሽን ቡድን አባላት የሆኑ አራት ተሟጋቾች በእንግሊዝ በሚገኝ የኤልቢት ሲስተምስ ፋብሪካ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል በሚል በተላለፈባቸው የእስር ውሳኔ ላይ ይግባኝ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ጉዳይ የንብረት ውድመት በአሸባሪነት እንዲመደብ በብሪታንያ ፍርድ ቤት ሲወሰን የመጀመሪያው በመሆኑ አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። አክቲቪስቶቹ ይህንን አወዛጋቢ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ለመሻር ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hirmaattota garee 'Palestine Action' kan ta'an namootni afur, buufata dhaabbata Elbit Systems kan UK keessa jiru irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru jedhamanii hidhamuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Dhimmi kun seenaa keessatti yeroo jalqabaatiif yakka qabeenya mancaasuu akka 'shororkeessummaa'tti fudhatamee murteeffamuun isaa kan adda ta'e dha. Amma gareen kun murtii seeraa mormuun akka haqamuuf iyyata dhiheeffachaa jiru.

title: Foreign fighters and external support fuel Sudan’s war: UN-backed probe
english: A UN-backed investigation reveals that Sudan's ongoing civil war is being significantly prolonged by foreign military support and the recruitment of international fighters. Both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces are utilizing advanced drones supplied by outside entities, leading to devastating civilian casualties and potential war crimes. This external involvement has turned a domestic conflict into a worsening humanitarian catastrophe that threatens the lives of millions.

oromo: Qorannoon dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniin deggerame akka ibsetti, waraanni sivilii Sudaan keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru gargaarsa alaa fi loltoota biyya alaa irraa dhufaniin akka cimu ta'eera. Gareewwan lamaanuu meeshaalee teeknooloojii waraanaa fi diroonii alaa argataniin namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuun yakka waraanaa raawwachuu danda'u. title: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say
english: Two Palestinian teenagers were killed during a confrontation involving Israeli settlers and military forces in the village of al-Mughayyir. Local officials claim the victims were trying to protect their livestock from settlers, while the Israeli military says they opened fire on violent instigators. This incident is part of a growing trend of violence in the West Bank, where residents face increasing threats and displacement efforts.
amharic: በአል-ሙጋይር መንደር በእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች እና በወታደሮች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሁለት የፍልስጤም ታዳጊዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ታዳጊዎቹ ከብቶቻቸውን ለመከላከል ሲሞክሩ እንደተገደሉ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በበኩሉ አመፅ ቀስቃሾችን ለመቆጣጠር መተኮሱን አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት በምዕራብ ባንክ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ግጭት የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ፍልስጤማውያን የመፈናቀል ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል።
oromo: Godina waldhabdee jiru keessatti, dargaggoonni Falasxiin lama baadiyaa Al-Mughayyir jedhamtu keessatti du'aniiru. Bulchiinsi naannichaa akka jedhutti, dargaggoonni kunneen horii isaanii saamamuu irraa ittisuuf yaalii gochaa turan; gareen waraana Israa'el garuu tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame walitti bu'iinsa uumame hordofee akka ta'e ibseera. title: Real Madrid’s Raul Asencio acquitted in sex-tape sharing case
english: Real Madrid defender Raul Asencio was acquitted of charges involving the non-consensual sharing of an explicit video after the victims chose to forgive the defendants. While the court dismissed his case, three other former youth players received suspended prison sentences for their roles in the incident. Separately, Asencio is facing disciplinary action from his club following a conviction for driving under the influence of alcohol.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ ተከላካይ ራውል አሴንሲዮ፣ የግል ምስልን ያለፈቃድ በማሰራጨት ክስ ከቀረበበት ጉዳይ ነፃ ሆኗል። ጉዳዩን የተመለከተው ፍርድ ቤት ተጎጂዎች ይቅርታ መጠየቃቸውን ተከትሎ ክሱን ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች ሶስት የቀድሞ የወጣት ቡድን ተጫዋቾች ግን በዚሁ ጉዳይ የእገዳ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። በሌላ በኩል አሴንሲዮ በአልኮል መጠጥ ተጽዕኖ ስር መኪና በማሽከርከር ጥፋተኛ በመባሉ ክለቡ ሪያል ማድሪድ በእሱ ላይ የዲሲፕሊን እርምጃ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Taphatni ittisaa garee Real Madrid Raul Asencio fiilmii saalaa hayyama malee qooduun himatamee ture seeraan bilisa ba'eera. Kun kan ta'e erga miidhamtoonni himatamtootaaf dhiifama godhanii booda yammuu ta'u, taphattoonni dargaggootaa sadan biroo garuu adabbii hidhaa yeroo qabanii akka turan murtaa'eera. Gama biraatiin, Asencio daandii irratti osoo machii jiru konkolaataa oofee argamuun isaa waan mirkanaa'eef, gareen isaa Real Madrid tarkaanfii angoo fudhachuu jalqabeera.

title: Houthi fighters clash with Yemeni government forces in country’s southwest
english: Houthi fighters have launched a significant offensive in Yemen's southwest, attempting to seize a critical supply road that connects Taiz to the port city of al-Makha. The conflict has resulted in dozens of casualties on both sides, with government forces reporting that they have managed to push back against the Houthi advances. This escalation raises concerns about a return to large-scale warfare in the region, particularly as the Houthis continue to target strategic areas near the Red Sea coast.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ደቡብ ምዕራብ ክፍል ወሳኝ የሆነውን የጣኢዝ እና የአል-ማካ ከተሞችን የሚያገናኝ መንገድ ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥቃት ከፍተዋል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል በተቀሰቀሰው ከባድ ውጊያ በሁለቱም በኩል በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። የመንግስት ወታደሮች የሁቲዎችን ጥቃት ለመመከት መቻላቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ ይህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በየመን ውስጥ ሙሉ በሙሉ ወደ ጦርነት የመመለስ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Finciltootni Huthis kibba-lixaa Yamanitti karaa magaala Taiz fi al-Makha wal-qunnamsiisu to’achuuf duula bal’aa bananiiru. Waraana cimaa kanaan garee lamaan irraas lubbuun namoota hedduu darbeera. Waraanni mootummaa haleellaa finciltootaa kana of irraa ittisuuf yaalii gochaa jiranis, tarkaanfiin kun Yamanitti waraanni bal’aan deebi’ee akka ka’u sodaachiseera.

title: Deadpool-Wolverine derby in the offing as Hugh Jackman targets Norwich City
english: Actor Hugh Jackman has expressed strong interest in purchasing a stake in the English football club Norwich City. This potential investment could lead to a friendly rivalry with his friend Ryan Reynolds, who successfully acquired and promoted Wrexham AFC. Both teams are currently competing in the Championship and hope to secure a spot in the Premier League this season.
amharic: ተዋናይ ሂው ጃክማን የእንግሊዝ እግር ኳስ ክለብ የሆነውን የኖርዊች ሲቲ የተወሰነ ድርሻ ለመግዛት ፍላጎት እንዳለው ገልጿል። ይህ ኢንቨስትመንት ከተፈጠረ፣ ወሬክስሃምን የገዛው ጓደኛው ራያን ሬይኖልድስ ጋር ተወዳዳሪ እንዲሆኑ ያደርጋቸዋል። ሁለቱም ክለቦች በአሁኑ ወቅት በሻምፒዮንሺፕ ሊግ የሚጫወቱ ሲሆን ወደ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ ለማደግ እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Aartistii Hugh Jackman kilabii kubbaa miilaa Ingiliiz kan ta'e Norwich City irratti qooda bituuf fedhii guddaa qabaachuu ibseera. Inni kun yoo milkaa'e, hiriyyaa isaa Ryan Reynolds kan kilabii Wrexham bituun beekamu waliin dorgommii tapha irratti akka waliin qabaatan taasisa. Gareewwan lamaanuu yeroo ammaa liigii Championship keessatti kan taphatan yoo ta'u, barana gara Premier League darbuuf abdii guddaa qabu.

title: 20 million children a year face online sexual abuse, UNICEF says
english: A recent UNICEF report indicates that approximately 20 million children across 21 countries face online sexual abuse or exploitation every year. Most of these incidents occur on social media platforms, yet very few cases are officially reported because children often feel afraid or unsure of how to seek help. This findings highlight a significant global crisis, as millions of youths are subjected to unwanted sexual content or the unauthorized sharing of their images.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የህጻናት መርጃ ድርጅት (ዩኒሴፍ) ይፋ ባደረገው አዲስ ዘገባ መሰረት በየዓመቱ በ21 ሀገራት የሚገኙ ወደ 20 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ህጻናት በኢንተርኔት አማካኝነት የጾታዊ ጥቃት ወይም ብዝበዛ ሰለባ እየሆኑ ነው። አብዛኛዎቹ እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መድረኮች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ቢሆንም፣ ህጻናት በፍርሃት ወይም እርዳታ ለማግኘት ባለመቻላቸው የተነሳ ጥቂት ጉዳዮች ብቻ ለባለስልጣናት ሪፖርት ይደረጋሉ። ይህ ጥናት በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ታዳጊዎች በግዴለሽነት ለሚሰራጩ የብልግና ምስሎች ወይም ያለፍላጎታቸው በሚፈጸም የጾታ ግንኙነት ጥያቄ እንደሚጋለጡ ያሳያል።

Qorannoon kun akka agarsiisutti, ijoolleen miiliyoonaan lakkaa'aman fedhii malee suuraa qullaa qooduuf ykn saal-qunnamtiif akka dirqisiifaman ibsa.

title: Billionaire Leon Black sues US congressional panel over Epstein subpoena
english: Billionaire Leon Black has filed a lawsuit against a US House committee to block subpoenas related to his past connections with Jeffrey Epstein. Black refused to attend a scheduled deposition, leading lawmakers to call for contempt of Congress charges against him. His legal team argues the investigation is an inappropriate overreach intended to damage his reputation rather than uncover facts.

oromo: Biliyeenarichi Leon Black qorannoo hariiroo isaa kan duraan Jeffrey Epstein wajjin ture ilaalchisee komitee Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummata Amerikaa irratti himata banateera. Black gaaffii fi deebii isaaf ramadame irratti dhihaachuu diduusaatiin, miseensonni komiteetichaa himata tuffii Mana Maree irratti akka banamu gaafataniiru. Gareen abukaattoota Black immoo, komiteetiin kun qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru dhugaa baasuuf osoo hin taane, maqaa isaa xureessuuf kan kaayyeffate akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
english: A powerful El Niño event is worsening drought conditions, leading to severe wildfires in Indonesia that have blanketed much of Southeast Asia in toxic smog. Millions of residents in countries like Malaysia, Singapore, and the Philippines are suffering from dangerous air quality levels, resulting in a surge of respiratory illnesses and other health complications. These recurring fires are largely attributed to long-standing environmental issues, including the clearing of forests and peatlands for industrial development.
amharic: ኃይለኛ የሆነው የኤልኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ድርቅን በማባባሱ በኢንዶኔዥያ ለተቀሰቀሱ ሰደድ እሳቶች መነሻ ሆኗል፤ ይህ ጭስም በአሁኑ ወቅት የደቡብ ምስራቅ እስያ ሀገራትን እያዳረሰ ይገኛል። በኢንዶኔዥያ፣ ማሌዢያ፣ ሲንጋፖር እና ፊሊፒንስ የሚኖሩ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ለከፍተኛ የአየር ብክለት በመጋለጣቸው ለተለያዩ የመተንፈሻ አካል በሽታዎች እየተዳረጉ ነው። እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ የጫካ እሳቶች በዋነኝነት የተከሰቱት በዘመናት ውስጥ ደኖችን እና ረግረጋማ መሬቶችን ለኢንዱስትሪ ልማት በመመንጠራቸው ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Mudannoon qilleensaa 'El Nino' jedhamu cimaan hammaachuu isaan, qilleensi gogiinsaa uumamee fi ibidda bosonaa Indoneeshiyaa keessatti ka'een guutuu Kibba-Baha Eeshiyaa irratti aaraan summii ta'e akka babal'atu taasiseera. Biyyoottan akka Maleeshiyaa, Singaappoor fi Filippiins keessatti namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman qilleensa faalame sanaan miidhamaa jiraachuu isaanii fi dhibeewwan narvii fi hafuraa irra gahuun gabaafameera. Ibiddoonni kun waggaa waggaan kan deddeebi'an yoo ta'u, rakkoo kanaaf sababa guddaan seenaa keessatti lafa bosonaa fi lafa jiidhaa iddoo jireenyaa fi qonnaaf jedhamee manca'uu dha.

title: More than 80 migrants feared dead after boat rescued off Canary Islands
english: A migrant boat that left The Gambia in early August was discovered adrift in the Atlantic Ocean after 27 days, with rescue teams finding 44 survivors and 5 bodies. Activists fear that over 80 people died during the dangerous journey to the Canary Islands. Due to hazardous weather and rough seas, rescuers were unable to recover the bodies from the vessel.
amharic: ከጋምቢያ ተነስቶ ወደ ካናሪ ደሴቶች ሲጓዝ የነበረ የስደተኞች ጀልባ በባህር ላይ ለ27 ቀናት ከቆየ በኋላ በስፓኒሽ የባህር ላይ አዳኞች ተገኝቷል። በጀልባው ላይ 44 ሰዎች በሕይወት ሲገኙ 5 አስከሬኖች ተገኝተዋል፣ ሆኖም ከ80 በላይ ሰዎች በአደጋው እንደሞቱ ተሰግቷል። አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታ እና ከፍተኛ ማዕበል በመኖሩ አዳኞች አስከሬኖቹን ከጀልባው ማውጣት አልቻሉም።
oromo: Dooniin godaantotaa Gamibiyaa irraa kaatee gara duubaatti imalaa turte guyyaa 27f galaana irratti erga haftee booda humnoonni fayyisaa namoota 44 lubbuun qaqqabaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, namoonni 80 ol ta'an imala kana irratti lubbuun darbuu isaanii sodaatama. Qilleensaa fi dambaliin galaanaa cimaa waan tureef, qaamoleen fayyisaa namoota du'anii argaman sanneen doonii irraa baasuu hin dandeenye.

title: UEFA opens disciplinary case against Fenerbahce’s Guendouzi and Greenwood
english: UEFA has launched a disciplinary investigation into Fenerbahce players Matteo Guendouzi and Mason Greenwood following their Champions League playoff match against Lyon. The players are accused of making offensive gestures toward opposing fans, which triggered a significant altercation between the teams. Fenerbahce plans to formally defend its players as the governing body reviews the chaotic events that occurred after the match.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበር (UEFA) የሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ማጣሪያ ጨዋታን ተከትሎ በፈነርባቼ ተጫዋቾች ማቴዮ ጉዌንዶዚ እና ሜሰን ግሪንዉድ ላይ የዲሲፕሊን ምርመራ ከፍቷል። ተጫዋቾቹ በሊዮን ደጋፊዎች ላይ ተገቢ ያልሆነ ምልክት በማሳየታቸው በሁለቱ ቡድኖች መካከል ግጭት ተቀስቅሶ ነበር። የቱርኩ ክለብ ፈነርባቼ የክለቡን እና የተጫዋቾቹን መብት ለማስከበር በሂደቱ ውስጥ አስፈላጊውን መከላከያ እንደሚያቀርብ አስታውቋል።
oromo: UEFA taphattoota Fenerbahce kan ta'an Matteo Guendouzi fi Mason Greenwood irratti qorannoo disiplinaa kan jalqabe tapha seensa Champions League Lyon wajjin taasisaniin booda. Taphattoonni kun deggertoota Lyon irratti gochaa jeequmsa uumuu danda'u raawwataniiru jedhamanii kan shakkaman yoo ta'u, kunis taphattoota gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumeera. Fenerbahce himannaa kana irraa taphattoota isaa ittisuuf qophiirra jiraachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Why has the Netherlands moved $10bn of its gold from the US?
english: The Dutch Central Bank has relocated $10 billion worth of its gold reserves from North America to the United Kingdom to improve financial security. This strategic move aims to diversify assets and boost the country's preparedness for potential global economic or geopolitical crises. By moving these holdings, the Netherlands intends to ensure its gold remains more accessible and resilient in an increasingly unstable international climate.
amharic: የኔዘርላንድስ ማዕከላዊ ባንክ የፋይናንስ ደህንነቱን ለማጠናከር 10 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የወርቅ ክምችቱን ከሰሜን አሜሪካ ወደ እንግሊዝ አስተላልፏል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የፖለቲካ እና የኢኮኖሚ አለመረጋጋት ለመቋቋም የሚያስችል ዝግጅት ለማድረግ ነው። ሀገሪቱ በችግር ጊዜ የወርቅ ክምችቷን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ መጠቀም እንዲቻል የሀብት ክፍፍሏን በማስተካከል ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Baankiin giddu galeessa biyya Netherlands, nageenya faayinaansii isaa cimsuuf jecha warqee doolaara biiliyoona 10 baasu kan ta'u, biyyoota Ameerikaa kaabaa irraa gara biyya Ingiliizitti jijjiireera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, rakkoolee diinagdee fi siyaasaa addunyaa irra jiran irratti of qopheessuufi. Netherlands, yeroo rakkoo keessatti warqeen ishee salphaatti akka argamuufi qabeenyi ishee akka eegamuuf jecha iddoo kuusaa warqee ishee kanas haala kanaan guurgeetti.

title: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem dies aged 92
english: Renowned feminist leader and writer Gloria Steinem has passed away in New York at the age of 92. A cofounder of Ms. Magazine, she spent decades traveling to advocate for women’s equality and bodily autonomy. Her legacy is defined by her dedication to social justice, her career as an influential journalist, and her unique ability to connect with others to drive change.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ የሴቶች መብት ተሟጋች እና ጸሐፊ ግሎሪያ ስታይነም በ92 ዓመታቸው በኒውዮርክ አርፈዋል። የኤም.ኤስ. መጽሔት መስራች የነበሩት ስታይነም ለሴቶች እኩልነት እና የሰውነት መብት ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ሲታገሉ ቆይተዋል። እርሳቸው በማህበራዊ ፍትህ ላይ የነበራቸው ቁርጠኝነት፣ የጋዜጠኝነት ስራቸው እና ሰዎችን የማነቃቃት ችሎታቸው እንደ ታላቅ የህይወት ታሪካቸው ይወሳል።
oromo: Gootuun mirga dubartootaa fi barreessituun bekkamtuun Gloriyaa Stayineem umurii waggaa 92tti magaalaa Niyoorkitti du'an. Hojiin isaanii kan yaadatamuu fi mirga hawaasummaa irratti qaban, akkasumas gaazexeessummaa fi namoota kakaasuuf dandeettii qaban sanaan seenaa keessatti ni yaadatu.

title: Families perform symbolic funerals for missing Nepal flood victims
english: Families in Nepal are holding symbolic funeral rites for relatives who went missing following severe flooding one week ago. Because no bodies have been recovered, people are using grass effigies to represent their loved ones during these ceremonies. These rituals indicate that grieving families are losing hope that any survivors will be found.

oromo: Nepaalkatti balaa lolaa torban tokko dura mudateen namoota badeef maatiin isaanii sirna awwaalchaa fakkeenyaa gaggeessaa jiru. Gochi kun abdii namoota badee lubbuun argachuu laaffachaa dhufuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Kenya’s aviation strike is over, but the dispute is far from settled
english: A two-day aviation strike in Kenya recently ended after government officials and union leaders reached a temporary agreement, allowing airports to resume normal operations. However, the core issues regarding wages, union recognition, and collective bargaining remain unresolved despite previous attempts to settle them. The dispute continues to be a point of tension, as workers and authorities return to the negotiating table to address these long-standing grievances.
amharic: በኬንያ ለሁለት ቀናት ተካሂዶ የነበረው የአቪዬሽን ሠራተኞች የሥራ ማቆም አድማ፣ የመንግሥት ባለሥልጣናት እና የሠራተኛ ማህበር መሪዎች ጊዜያዊ ስምምነት ላይ በመድረሳቸው ተቋርጧል። ይሁን እንጂ የደመወዝ ጭማሪን፣ የማህበር ዕውቅናን እና የጋራ ድርድርን የሚመለከቱ ዋና ዋና ችግሮች እስካሁን መፍትሄ አላገኙም። ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ስምምነቶች ውጤታማ ባለመሆናቸው፣ አሁን የተፈጠረው አለመግባባት በድርድር ጠረጴዛ ላይ እንደሚቀጥል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hiriirri mormii hojjettoota xiyyaaraa Keeniyaa keessatti guyyoota lamaaf gaggeeffamaa ture, mootummaa fi hogganoonni gamtaa hojjettootaa walii galtee yerootii tokko irra erga ga'anii booda xumurameera. Haa ta'u malee, rakkooleen gurguddoon kan akka kafaltii mindaa, beekamtii gamtaa fi marii gamtaa waliinii ammayyuu furmaata hin arganne. Kanaan dura mariin godhamaa ture waan hin milkoofneef, wal dhibdeen kun ammayyuu itti fufuu fi mariin gara fuulduraatti itti fufuun isaa kan hin oolleedha.

title: Iran warns ‘dark months’ await US economy after renewed attacks
english: Iranian First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref has threatened that the US economy faces difficult times ahead following recent military tensions between the two nations. This warning comes after President Donald Trump suggested the possibility of US military strikes against Iran and claimed control over the vital Strait of Hormuz. In response, Iran has pledged to launch a complex and asymmetrical retaliation against American interests.
amharic: የኢራን ቀዳሚ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት መሐመድ ረዛ አሬፍ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል በተፈጠረው የቅርብ ጊዜ ውጥረት የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ ከባድ ፈተና እንደሚጠብቀው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰማው የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ጥቃት ሊሰነዘር እንደሚችል እና በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላቸው ከተናገሩ በኋላ ነው። ኢራን በበኩሏ ለዚህ አጸፋዊ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ዝግጁ መሆኗን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Itti-aanaan Pirezidaantii Iraan Mohammad Reezaa Areef, walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti uumameen dinagdeen Ameerikaa yeroo ulfaataa keessa akka seenu akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga Pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Iraanirratti haleellaa raawwachuu akka danda'anii fi bishaan daangaa Hormuuz to'annoo isaanii jala akka jiru ibsanii booda. Iraanis tarkaanfii kanaan walqabatee haaloo ba'uuf qophii ta'uu ishee beeksisiteetti.

title: Israeli settlers 'hike' through my West Bank village. Next is the violent land grab
english: Residents of the West Bank village of Qira are raising alarms as armed Israeli settlers have begun conducting regular, unauthorized tours of their land. Villagers fear these hikes are a tactical scouting method used to claim historical ties to the area and pave the way for future territorial seizures. Similar activities in other areas have previously escalated into violent confrontations and the destruction of Palestinian homes.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው የቂራ መንደር ነዋሪዎች የታጠቁ እስራኤላዊያን ሰፋሪዎች ወደ መንደራቸው በየጊዜው መግባታቸውን በመቃወም ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። መንደሩን የሚጎበኙት እነዚህ ቡድኖች ለወደፊቱ መሬቱን ለመቆጣጠር በማቀድ በታሪካዊ ስፍራዎች ላይ የይገባኛል ጥያቄ እያነሱ መሆኑን ነዋሪዎቹ ይናገራሉ። ተመሳሳይ ድርጊቶች በሌሎች አካባቢዎች ወደ ግጭትና የንብረት ውድመት ማምራታቸው ለነዋሪዎቹ ትልቅ ስጋት ሆኗል።
oromo: Namoonni magaalaa Qiraa jedhamtu kan West Bank keessatti argamtu, gareen qubattoota Israa'el meeshaa hidhatanii gara baadiyaa isaanii deddeebi'anii dhufuun isaanii yaaddoo guddaa uumeera. Jiraattonni akka jedhanitti, daawwannaan kun lafa isaanii fuudhuuf karoorfamee kan adeemsifamu yoo ta'u, iddoowwan seena qabeeyyii irratti mirga abbummaa himachuuf kan fayyaduudha. Akkaataa kanaan dura bakkeewwan biroo keessatti mul'ateen, sochiiwwan akkanaa gara walitti bu'iinsaatti fi manneen jireenyaa gubachuutti akka geessu sodaatameera.

title: Palestinian Islamic Jihad co-founder threatened with 'unlawful' deportation from Syria
english: Adel al-Natour, a 71-year-old co-founder of Palestinian Islamic Jihad, has been held in Syria without trial for nearly a year. His family recently received notice that he faces imminent deportation, despite authorities previously promising his release. Legal experts and family members are struggling to intervene because he is being detained arbitrarily without any formal charges.
amharic: የፍልስጤም እስላማዊ ጂሃድ መስራች የሆኑት የ71 ዓመቱ አዴል አል-ናቱር፣ ሶሪያ ውስጥ ያለ ክስ ለአንድ ዓመት ያህል ታስረዋል። ባለስልጣናት ቀደም ሲል ቢፈቱትም አሁን በድንገት ከሀገር ሊያባርሩት እንደሆነ ለቤተሰቡ አሳውቀዋል። በምንም አይነት መደበኛ ክስ ያልቀረበባቸው በመሆኑ፣ ቤተሰቦቻቸው እና የህግ ባለሙያዎች ይህንን የውጭ ሀገር የማባረር ውሳኔ ለመቃወም ተቸግረዋል።
oromo: Adel al-Natour, namni umrii 71 fi hundeessaa garee Palestinian Islamic Jihad ta'e, Suuriya keessatti waggaa tokkoof mana hidhaa kan ture yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti himannaan tokkollee irratti hin banamne. Qaamoleen mootummaa duraan akka isa gadi dhiisan waadaa seenus, amma garuu biyyattiin ariitii dhaan isa baasuuf karoorfatte jirti. Maatiin isaa fi abbootiin seeraa himannaan seeraan ala ta'e kun akka dhaabatu gochuuf dhama'aa jiran.

title: Blair Institute denies former UK PM asked PA to remove 'Palestine' from school textbooks
english: The Tony Blair Institute has officially denied allegations that the former UK Prime Minister pressured the Palestinian Authority to delete the word 'Palestine' from educational materials. These claims originated from former diplomat Jeremy Greenstock, who suggested Blair was acting on behalf of a US-led peace committee. The institute firmly rejected these reports, labeling the accusations as entirely false and without any factual basis.
amharic: የቶኒ ብሌየር ተቋም የቀድሞው የእንግሊዝ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር በትምህርት መጻሕፍት ውስጥ 'ፍልስጤም' የሚለውን ቃል እንዲያስወግድ መጠየቃቸውን የሚያሳይ ዘገባ በይፋ አስተባብለዋል። ይህ ክስ የተሰማው የቀድሞው ዲፕሎማት ጄረሚ ግሪንስቶክ ብሌየር በአሜሪካ የሚመራ የሰላም ኮሚቴን ወክለው ይህን ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል በማለታቸው ነው። ተቋሙ በበኩሉ እነዚህ ዘገባዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ሀሰት እና ምንም አይነት መሰረት የሌላቸው መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ውድቅ አድርጓቸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Tony Blair, gaaffii duraanii muummichi ministeeraa biyya Ingiliz aangoo Filisxeemii irraa barreeffama barnootaa keessatti jecha 'Filisxeem' jedhu akka balleessan dhiibbaa godhan jedhamee dhiyaate haale jira. Himannaan kun kan ka'e, diippiloomaatii duraanii Jeremy Greenstock, Blair koree nagaa Ameerikaan durfamu bakka bu'uudhaan gaaffii kana akka dhiyeessan dubbachuu isaanii hordofee dha. Dhaabbatichi gama isaatiin, oduun kun dhugaa kan hin qabneefi bu'uura kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsuun guutummaatti gadi dhisee jira.

title: Xi’s Egypt visit tests Cairo’s balancing act
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping recently visited Egypt to celebrate 70 years of diplomatic ties, resulting in new agreements on trade, artificial intelligence, and renewable energy. The visit featured the expansion of the Suez Canal economic zone, a strategic move for Egypt as it seeks to boost revenue following a major drop in canal traffic. By deepening these ties, Egypt aims to balance its international relations while integrating its national development goals with China's global infrastructure plans.
amharic: የቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ የሁለቱን ሀገራት የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት 70ኛ ዓመት ምክንያት በማድረግ ግብፅን ጎብኝተዋል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት በንግድ፣ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) እና በታዳሽ ኃይል ዘርፎች በርካታ ስምምነቶች ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ትብብር የሱዌዝ ካናል ኢኮኖሚ ቀጠናን በማስፋፋት የግብፅን የኢኮኖሚ ተግዳሮቶች ለመቅረፍ ያለመ ሲሆን፣ ግብፅ ከቻይና ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት ከአገራዊ የልማት እቅዷ ጋር በማቀናጀት ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Chaayinaa Sii Jinpiing waggaa 70ffaa hariiroo dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii kabajuuf gara Masrii imalaniiru. Imala kana keessatti waliigaltee daldalaa, teeknoolojii AI fi anniisaa haaromfamuu irratti mallatteessaniiru. Masriin diinagdee ishee cimsuufi qaxxaamura galaana Suweez irraa galii argamu dabaluuf jedhee, qaxxaamurichi Chaayinaa waliin walitti dhufeenya isaa cimseera; kunis karoora misooma Masrii fi Chaayinaa walitti fiduuf gargaara.

title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
english: The United Nations has issued a warning regarding an exceptionally powerful El Niño event that is expected to bring severe weather disruptions, including droughts and intense flooding, until early 2027. Climate experts highlight that this phenomenon, combined with human-caused global warming, could trigger record-breaking temperatures and significant environmental damage. Governments and international agencies are currently strengthening early warning systems and emergency preparations to protect vulnerable populations from these potential disasters.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እስከ የካቲት 2027 ሊቆይ የሚችል እጅግ አደገኛ የሆነ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ወይም ኤል ኒኞ (El Niño) በዓለማችን ላይ ሊከሰት እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል። ይህ ክስተት ከሰው ሰራሽ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ጋር ተዳምሮ በዓለም ዙሪያ ድርቅን እና ከፍተኛ ጎርፍን ጨምሮ ከባድ የአየር ሁኔታዎችን ሊያስከትል ይችላል። መንግስታት እና አለም አቀፍ ተቋማት በአየር ንብረት ለውጡ ሊጎዱ የሚችሉ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ አስቀድሞ የማስጠንቀቂያ ስርዓቶችን በማጠናከር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomani, qilleensa 'El Niino' jedhamu kan haalaan cimaa ta'eefi hanga Guraandhala 2027 tureruu danda'u tokko akka mudatu akeekkachiiseera. Haalli kun jijjiirama qilleensa nam-tolchee waliin walitti dabalamuudhaan, addunyaa irratti hongee cimaafi rooba lolaa fiduun miidha guddaa dhaqqabsiisuu danda'a. Mootummoonniifi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa miidhaa kana xiqqeessuuf, sirnoota akeekkachiisa duraa diriirsuufi qophiiwwan barbaachisoo ta'an godhachaa jiru.

title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
english: People smuggling gangs in northern France are increasingly using larger boats, known as 'mega-dinghies,' because authorities have restricted the supply of standard small vessels. This shift in tactics comes as French and UK police intensify efforts to intercept crossings, forcing gangs to consolidate more passengers into single boats despite the increased danger. Consequently, the cost for migrants attempting these illegal journeys has risen significantly, reaching up to €2,000 per person.
amharic: በሰሜን ፈረንሳይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የሰዎች አዘዋዋሪ ቡድኖች በመደበኛ ጀልባዎች አቅርቦት ላይ በተጣለው ቁጥጥር ምክንያት 'ሜጋ-ዲንጊስ' የሚባሉ ትላልቅ ጀልባዎችን መጠቀም ጀምረዋል። የፈረንሳይ እና የዩኬ ፖሊስ የሚያደርጉት ጥብቅ ክትትል አዘዋዋሪዎቹን ብዙ ሰዎችን በአንድ ትልቅ ጀልባ ላይ እንዲጭኑ ያስገደዳቸው ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለአደጋ የተጋለጠ ጉዞን እየፈጠረ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት ህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ለሚጓዙ ስደተኞች የሚጠየቀው ክፍያ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሮ ወደ 2,000 ዩሮ ደርሷል።
oromo: Hojii seeraan alaa namoota ceesisuu irratti kan bobba'an gareewwan Faransaay kaabaa, to'annoo markaboobni xixiqqoo irratti godhameen kan ka'e markabooba gurguddaa 'mega-dinghies' jedhamanitti fayyadamuu jalqabaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe poolisiin Faransaay fi UK daandii kanneen to'achuuf carraaqqii cimaa waan godhaniif, gareewwan kunneen imimmoo namoota hedduu markabooba tokko keessatti walitti qabanii akka fe'an isaan dirqisiiseera. Haala kanaan, baasiin godaantota karaa seeraan alaa kana fayyadamanii hanga Euro 2,000 ga'uun isaa gabaafameera.

title: Trump $1 coin makes him first living president on US currency in a century
english: The US Mint has released a new one-dollar coin featuring Donald Trump, marking the first time a living president has appeared on American currency in 100 years. This special-edition coin was created to commemorate the country's upcoming 250th anniversary. Although the coins sold out quickly online, they are made of copper alloys rather than real gold.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ማተሚያ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ምስል የተዘጋጀ አዲስ የአንድ ዶላር ሳንቲም አስተዋውቋል፤ ይህም ባለፉት 100 ዓመታት ውስጥ በሥልጣን ላይ ያለ ፕሬዚዳንት በገንዘብ ላይ ሲታይ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ነው። ይህ ልዩ ሳንቲም የአገሪቱን 250ኛ ዓመት በዓል ምክንያት በማድረግ የተሠራ ነው። ሳንቲሞቹ በኢንተርኔት አማካኝነት በፍጥነት የተሸጡ ሲሆን፣ የተሠሩትም ከወርቅ ሳይሆን ከመዳብ ድብልቅ ነው።
oromo: Biroon maallaqa biyyattii (US Mint) saantima dolaara tokko kan fuula Donald Trump qabu baaseera; kunis waggaa 100 keessatti pirezidaantiin lubbuun jiran tokko maallaqa irratti yeroo mul'atan isa jalqabaati. Saantimni addaa kun ayyaana waggaa 250ffaa biyyattii yaadachuuf kan qophaaye dha. Saantimoonni kun marsariitii irratti hatattamaan kan dhumatan yoo ta'u, kanneenis warqee osoo hin taane sibiila biroo irraa kan hojjetaman dha.

title: NBA fines Clippers $30m, suspends several executives in Kawhi Leonard probe
english: The NBA has imposed a $30 million fine and stripped five first-round draft picks from the Los Angeles Clippers for violating salary cap rules involving Kawhi Leonard. Investigations revealed the team helped Leonard secure off-court income through prohibited endorsement deals and improperly paid his personal expenses. Additionally, owner Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year, and several other key executives faced suspensions for their roles in the misconduct.
amharic: የኤንቢኤ (NBA) የሎስ አንጀለስ ክሊፐርስ ቡድን በካዋይ ሌናርድ ዝውውር እና ክፍያ ዙሪያ የደመወዝ ጣሪያ ህጎችን በመጣሱ የ30 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ቅጣት እና የአምስት ዓመት የመጀመርያ ዙር የጨዋታ ምርጫዎችን ሰርዟል። የተደረገው ምርመራ ቡድኑ ለተጫዋቹ ህገ-ወጥ የገቢ ምንጮችን እና የንግድ ስምምነቶችን በማመቻቸት ለግል ወጪዎቹ ሽፋን እንደሰጠ አረጋግጧል። የቡድኑ ባለቤት ስቲቭ ባልመር ለአንድ ዓመት ከስራ ታግደዋል፣ ሌሎች የቡድኑ ከፍተኛ አመራሮችም በተመሳሳይ በተፈጠረው ጥሰት ምክንያት ቅጣት ተላልፎባቸዋል።
oromo: Liigii kubbaa basketbolii (NBA) garee Los Angeles Clippers irratti adabbii dolaara miiliyoona 30 fi kutaalee taphattoota filachuu shan kan waggoota dhufan jiraniin haqee jira. Adabbiin kun kan hordofame erga qorannoon gareen kun Kawhi Leonardif daldala dhokataa fi kafaltii seeraan alaa mijeessuu isaa fi baasii isaa hunda kan kaffale ta'uu mirkaneeffateen booda. Abbaan qabeenyaa garee kanaa Steve Ballmer waggaa tokkoof hojiirraa kan dhorkaman yoo ta'u, hoggantoonni olaanoon biroos badii kana keessatti hirmaachuu isaaniitiin adabbii irra ga'ee jira.

title: Russia to close Goethe-Institut centres as Germany tensions escalate
english: Russia is shutting down all Goethe-Institut cultural centers across the country following Germany's decision to close Russian institutions in Berlin and Bonn. This move comes as diplomatic tensions surge after a drone incident at a German airport, which European officials have labeled as a potential act of state-sponsored sabotage. While German authorities accuse Russia of organizing this hybrid attack, the Kremlin has denied involvement and labeled the German reaction as unreasonable.
amharic: ጀርመን በበርሊን እና በቦን የሚገኙ የሩሲያ ተቋማትን ለመዝጋት መወሰኗን ተከትሎ ሩሲያ በሀገሪቱ የሚገኙትን የጎተ-ኢንስቲትዩት ባህላዊ ማዕከላት እንደምትዘጋ አስታውቃለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በጀርመን አየር ማረፊያ ላይ የተከሰተውን የድሮን ጥቃት ተከትሎ የሁለቱ ሀገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ነው። የአውሮፓ ህብረት እና የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ድርጊት የሩሲያ የሽብር ሙከራ ሲሉ ሲከሱ፣ የክሬምሊን አስተዳደር ግን ክሱ መሰረተ ቢስ ነው በማለት ውድቅ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Jarmanin buufataalee aadaa Raashiyaa kanneen Berlin fi Bonn keessatti argaman cufuuf murteessuu ishee hordofee, Raashiyaan dhaabbileen aadaa Goethe-Institut guutummaa biyyattii keessatti argaman akka cufaman labsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga buufata xiyyaaraa Jarman keessatti dhukaatin qilleensaa (drone) muudatee booda walitti bu’iinsi dippilomaasii lamaan gidduutti hammaatee jira. Aangootiifi qaamoleen Awurooppaa haleellaa kana sochii sabootaatiin raawwatame jechuun yoo himatan, mootummaan Raashiyaa garuu himannaa kana dhimmicha irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf dhiyaate jechuun haaleera.

title: OpenAI’s Sam Altman tells G20 AI will be as essential as electricity
english: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently advised G20 leaders to adopt artificial intelligence, comparing its future importance to that of electricity. He emphasized that AI will be a fundamental tool for the next generation, suggesting that ignoring its potential would be a significant historical mistake. Altman believes that integrating this technology is essential for progress in the modern era.
amharic: የOpenAI ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ሳም አልትማን የጂ20 ሀገራት መሪዎች አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን (AI) እንዲቀበሉ መክረዋል። የቴክኖሎጂውን አስፈላጊነት እንደ ኤሌክትሪክ መሰረታዊ እንደሆነ የገለፁት አልትማን፣ እሱን ችላ ማለት እንደ ኢንዱስትሪያል ዘመን የኤሌክትሪክ ሃይልን እንደመካድ ያለ ስህተት ነው ብለዋል። ይህ ቴክኖሎጂ ለወደፊት ትውልድ ወሳኝ መሳሪያ በመሆኑ፣ ሀገራት ሊጠቀሙበት እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata OpenAI Saam Altmaan, gorsaa fi yaada isaa gaggeessitoota biyyoota G20f qooduun, teknoolojiin 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) akka ibsaa fayyadamuu akka qaban dhaame. Altmaan akka jedhutti, AI gara fuulduraatti akka humna ibsaa barbaachisaa kan ta'uufi, kana fudhachuu diduun dogoggora seenaa keessa darbuu dha. Dhaloota haaraaf teknoolojichi meeshaa murteessaa waan ta'eef, biyyoonni fayyadamuu akka qaban gorseera.

title: Alcaraz, Sabalenka ease into US Open third round; American players shine
english: Tennis stars Carlos Alcaraz and Aryna Sabalenka successfully advanced to the third round of the US Open despite challenging conditions and some match delays. Several American players, including Jessica Pegula, Ben Shelton, and Frances Tiafoe, also secured victories to move further in the tournament. Alcaraz performed well despite early concerns about a wrist injury, while other top contenders like Daniil Medvedev also progressed to the next stage.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከቦች ካርሎስ አልካራዝ እና አሪና ሳባሌንካ በዩኤስ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር በተሳካ ሁኔታ ወደ ሶስተኛው ዙር ማለፋቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። እንደ ጄሲካ ፔጉላ፣ ቤን ሼልተን እና ፍራንሲስ ቲያፎ ያሉ አሜሪካዊ ተጫዋቾችም ድል በማድረግ ወደ ቀጣዩ ምዕራፍ ተሸጋግረዋል። አልካራዝ ቀደም ሲል በነበረበት የእጅ አንጓ ጉዳት ስጋት ውስጥ ቢሆንም አቋሙን በማሻሻል ወደ ቀጣዩ ዙር ማለፍ ችሏል።
oromo: Taphattoonni tenisii beekamoo Kaarloos Alkaaraaz fi Ariinaa Saabaleenkaas dorgommii US Open irratti gara sadarkaa sadaffaatti darbuu danda'aniiru. Akkasumas taphattoonni Ameerikaa kanneen akka Jeesiikaa Peeguulaa, Ben Sheeltan fi Firaansis Tiyaafoon injifannoo argachuun gara dorgommii itti aanuutti ce'aniiru. Alkaaraaz miidhaa harka isaa duraan qabu turu illee, dandeettii isaa agarsiisuun gara sadarkaa itti aanuutti darbeera.

title: Iran Red Crescent urges ICC probe into deadly US strike on wedding party
english: The Iranian Red Crescent has requested that the International Criminal Court investigate a recent US missile strike on a wedding in Kuhestak. The attack resulted in the deaths of four people, including two children, and left 67 others injured. The humanitarian organization argues that targeting a civilian gathering is a potential war crime, while the US military has denied allegations that it deliberately attacks civilians.
amharic: የኢራን ቀይ ጨረቃ ማህበር በኩሄስታክ በሰርግ ላይ የደረሰውን የአሜሪካ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት እንዲመረምር ጠይቋል። ጥቃቱ ሁለት ሕጻናትን ጨምሮ የአራት ሰዎችን ሕይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን ሌሎች 67 ሰዎች ደግሞ እንዲቆስሉ አድርጓል። የሰብአዊ መብት ድርጅቱ በሲቪሎች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ይህን ድርጊት የጦር ወንጀል ሊሆን እንደሚችል ሲገልጽ፣ የአሜሪካ ጦር ግን በሲቪሎች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ጥቃት እንደማይፈጽም በማስታወቅ ክሱን አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Hawaasni Ji'a Diimaa Iraan, miilaa duulaa Ameerikaan magaalaa Kuhestakitti cidha tokko irratti raawwatame irratti qorannoon akka gaggeeffamu Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaaf gaaffii dhiyeesseera. Duulichi lubbuu namoota afurii kan galaafate yoo ta'u, ijoollee lama dabalatee namoonni 67 miidhamaniiru. Dhaabbatichi haleellaan kun yakka waraanaa ta'uu isaa ibsee, mootummaan Ameerikaa gama isaatiin siviliin irratti haleellaa akka hin raawwanne ifatti haaleera.

title: 'Inappropriate to say': Trump may still be considering CIA-led uprising in Iran
english: President Trump recently declined to clarify whether he would authorize the CIA to arm Iranian citizens for a potential uprising. This follows recent U.S. military strikes in Iran that resulted in multiple civilian casualties. While Trump expressed sympathy for protesters, his claims regarding the specific number of deaths in the country remain unverified.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን አመጽ እንዲቀሰቀስ የሲአይኤ ታጣቂዎችን ስለመላክ የሚጠየቀውን ጥያቄ በግልጽ ለመመለስ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ይህ የሆነው አሜሪካ በኢራን የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በፈጸመችው እና የበርካታ ንጹሃን ህይወት ባጠፋው ጥቃት ማግስት ነው። ትራምፕ ለኢራን ተቃዋሚዎች ያላቸውን አጋርነት ቢገልጹም፣ የተጠቀሱት የተጎጂዎች ቁጥር ግን በይፋ የተረጋገጠ አይደለም።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp mootummaan Ameerikaa finxaaleeyyii Iraan hidhachiisuun akka ka’an gochuuf CIA fayyadamuu danda’uu isaa irratti ibsa kennuuf fedhii hin qabne. Kunis kan ta’e yeroo Ameerikaan naannoo qarqara galaana Iraanitti haleellaa raawwatteen lubbuun namoota baay’ee darbee ture booda dha. Traamp gadda isaanii ibsuun kan dubbatan ta’us, lakkoofsi namoota du’anii jedhan garuu mirkanaa’aa miti.

title: UK must reject attempts to derail settlement trade ban
english: The UK government is considering a ban on trade with illegal Israeli settlements following international pressure and rising public dissatisfaction with past policies. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has proposed comprehensive measures in response to aggressive settlement expansion and ongoing violence in the West Bank. However, the government faces significant opposition from pro-Israel groups and the Israeli authorities, who are threatening retaliation to prevent these sanctions from taking effect.

Ta'us, mootummaan kun gareewwan Israa'el deggeran fi mootummaa Israa'el irraa mormii cimaa kan mudate yoo ta'u, isaanis tarkaanfiin kun akka hin milkoofneef miidhaa geessisuuf doorsisaa jiru.

title: UAE President and Trump hold phone call over Middle East developments
english: US President Donald Trump and UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan spoke over the phone to review current events in the Middle East. The two leaders focused on enhancing their collaborative relationship and discussed strategies to advance their shared interests. This conversation highlights the ongoing diplomatic engagement between the two nations.

oromo: Pirezedantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraampii fi Pirezedantiin Emereetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii Sheek Mohaammad biin Zaayid Al Naahayaan haala yeroo biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaa irratti bilbilaan mari'ataniiru. Hogganoonni kunneen hariiroo biyyoota lameenii caalaatti cimsuu fi faayidaa waliinii irratti xiyyeeffachuun mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun hariiroo diippiloomaasii biyyoota lameenii gidduu jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Netanyahu says Israel working to overthrow Iran’s government
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently stated that his administration is actively pursuing the removal of the current Iranian government. During the same interview, he noted his satisfaction with military operations in Gaza and claimed that Israeli forces now hold territory across more than 60 percent of the strip. These comments highlight Israel's dual focus on aggressive foreign policy toward Iran and ongoing ground efforts in Palestinian territories.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የእስራኤል መንግስት የአሁኑን የኢራን አስተዳደር ከስልጣን ለማውረድ እየሰራ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ ቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ በጋዛ ስላለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ያላቸውን እርካታ የገለጹት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ፣ እስራኤል አሁን ከ60 በመቶ በላይ የሚሆነውን የጋዛ ግዛት እንደምትቆጣጠር ተናግረዋል። ይህ መግለጫ እስራኤል በኢራን ላይ ያላትን ጠንካራ አቋም እና በጋዛ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ያሳያል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Israa'el Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu, mootummaan isaanii sirna mootummaa Iiraan amma jiru buusuuf hojjechaa akka jiru ibsan. Gaafii fi deebii kanaan, waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru irratti gammachuu qaban ibsuun, humnoonni Israa'el amma lafa Gaazaa keessaa dhibbeentaa 60 ol to'achuu isaanii dubbataniiru. Ibsi kun Israa'el gama kanaan siyaasa alaa Iiraan irratti qabduu fi duula waraanaa Gaazaa keessatti geggeessaa jirtu kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Morning update
english: Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated following heavy American airstrikes that resulted in 18 deaths and over 140 injuries, many of whom were women and children. Iran responded by placing additional naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz to challenge US claims of control over the waterway. Meanwhile, the UN is calling for an urgent return to diplomatic negotiations to reach a peaceful resolution, while US officials continue to coordinate with regional partners on potential future military actions.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ ተባብሷል፣ ይህም የ18 ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን ከ140 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ኢራን የአሜሪካን የባህር መንገድ ቁጥጥር ለመቃወም በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ ተጨማሪ ፈንጂዎችን እንደጣለች አስታውቃለች። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ሁለቱንም ወገኖች በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ችግሮቻቸውን እንዲፈቱ ሲያሳስብ፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ግን ለቀጣይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ከክልሉ አጋሮቻቸው ጋር እየተመካከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Harka lachuu gidduutti waraanni fi wal-dhibdeen erga weerara qilleensaarraa kanneen lubbuun darbee fi kanneen miidhaman lakkoofsi isaanii gahuun booda hammaachaa jira. Iraan to'annoo Ameerikaa kan karaa bishaan Hormuz irratti qabdu mormuuf, bishaanicha keessatti minaalee dabalataa kaa'uushee beeksisite. Gamtaan Mootummootaa biyyoota lamaan mariidhaan furmaata akka barbaadan gaafachaa jirullee, mootummaan Ameerikaa garuu tarkaanfii waraanaa gara fuulduraa irratti hiriyoota naannichaa wajjin mari'achaa jira.

title: Tens of thousands rally across Spain over Ceuta migrant crisis
english: Massive crowds gathered in various Spanish cities to demonstrate against the government's management of a recent migration crisis in Ceuta. Protesters expressed their frustration, claiming that authorities failed to handle the situation effectively. Additionally, many participants accused Morocco of playing a direct role in the sudden influx of migrants at the border.

oromo: Magaalota Ispeen garaa garaa keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman mootummaan rakkoo godaantotaa Ceuta irratti uumame hordofee tarkaanfii fudhate mormuun hiriira ba'aniiru. Hiriirtotni mootummaan rakkoo kana furuuf dandeettii dhabe jechuun komataniiru. title: Maltese tycoon acquitted of killing journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia
english: A Maltese businessman named Yorgen Fenech has been found not guilty of orchestrating the 2017 car bomb assassination of investigative reporter Daphne Caruana Galizia. Fenech had maintained his innocence throughout the trial regarding his involvement in the attack. The journalist's death previously caused significant public unrest in Malta, eventually leading to the resignation of the country's Prime Minister.
amharic: ዮርገን ፌኔች የተባሉ የማልታ የንግድ ሰው በ2017 ዓ.ም የምርመራ ጋዜጠኛዋን ዳፍኒ ካሩአና ጋሊዚያን በመኪና ቦምብ ለመግደል አቅደዋል ተብለው የቀረበባቸው ክስ ውድቅ ተደረገ። ፌኔች በችሎቱ ላይ በጥቃቱ ውስጥ ምንም አይነት ተሳትፎ እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብለዋል። የጋዜጠኛዋ ግድያ በማልታ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞን ያስነሳ ሲሆን ይህም የሀገሪቱን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ከስልጣን እንዲለቁ አስገድዷቸዋል።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa biyya Maaltaa Yorgen Fenech jedhaman, bara 2017 gaazexeessituu qorattu Daphne Caruana Galizia boombii konkolaataan ajjeesuu irratti harka qabu jedhamanii himatamanis, mana murtii irraa bilisa ta'aniiru. Fenech yakka kana irratti hirmaannaa akka hin qabne ibsuun himannaa irratti dhiyaate haalaniiru. Duuti gaazexeessituu tanaatiis biyya Maaltaa keessatti mormii guddaa kaasee, dhumarratti muummicha ministeeraa biyyattii aangoo gadhiisuuf dirqisiiseera.

title: US forces board and destroy alleged cartel boat in eastern Pacific
english: The United States military intercepted and destroyed a vessel in the eastern Pacific Ocean that was being used as a mobile fueling station for drug smugglers. Officials suspect that the individuals on board belonged to the Los Choneros criminal organization based in Ecuador. The entire operation was documented by military cameras.

oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa galaana Paasifiik bahaatti doonii gurgurtoota sammuu namaa hadochanneessan (drug) boba'aadhaan gargaaruuf gargaaraa turte to'annoo jala oolchanii barbadeessaniiru. Namoonni doonii sanarra turan garee yakka 'Los Choneros' jedhamu kan Ekuwadoor keessatti argamu irraa dhufuu akka malu shakkameera. Hojiin kunis suuraa kaameran waraanaatiin qindaa'ee galmeeffameera.

title: Minneapolis shooting kills two, wounds three police officers
english: A shooting at a Minneapolis apartment complex resulted in the deaths of two victims and the suspected gunman. Three police officers were also injured during the response but remain in stable condition. Local authorities and state officials are currently investigating the incident to determine the motive behind the attack.
